# GroundApp

> GroundApp is a breathwork app for iPhone and Apple Watch, created by Collin Chartier, a breathwork and mental performance coach. It has 35 breathing techniques across calming, energizing, focusing and balancing, guided sessions narrated in Collin's voice, and a daily check-in that matches how you feel to a breathing session. Free to download on the App Store. Website: https://groundapp.live

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/groundapp-breathwork/id6760352779
- Rated 5.0 on the US App Store (11 ratings as of October 2026)
- Requires iOS 17 or later. The Apple Watch app requires watchOS 11 or later.

## Pricing

- Free to download. Four techniques are free forever: Box Breathing, Deep Slow Breathing, 2-to-1 Breathing and Triangle Breathing. The breathing timer, streaks and basic stats are free too.
- GroundApp Premium is $39.99 a year (US). It opens all 35 techniques, 15 guided sessions and the daily check-in. Billed through Apple; cancel any time in Apple ID settings.

## Features

- 35 breathing techniques across calming, energizing, focusing and balancing, including progressive Box Breathing variants.
- 15 guided sessions narrated in Collin Chartier's voice. The narration is an AI model of Collin's voice, trained on his own recordings. Collin is the only instructor.
- Daily check-in: a feelings wheel with 102 feelings (6 core, 24, 72), plus intensity and energy, that matches you to a breathing session. The matching is rule-based. Optional, before a session.
- After-session reflection: rating, how you feel, a note, and a share card.
- BOLT CO2 tolerance test (free).
- Apple Watch app: Box Breathing, Physiological Sigh, Resonance and Instant Calm on the wrist, with haptic breath cues and live heart rate.
- Apple Health: reads HRV, resting heart rate, sleep and respiratory rate (and more); writes Mindful Minutes.
- Whoop, Garmin, Oura, COROS and other wearables come in through Apple Health. Bluetooth heart-rate straps are supported. Live heart rate and HRV during sessions.
- Instant Calm: one tap, no voice, works offline.
- Quick fixes for Sleep, Anxiety, Focus, Energy, Headache and Stress. 7 collections (for example Bedtime Wind-Down and Morning Ritual). 6 Learn modules on the nervous system.
- Build your own breathing sequences with haptics and a counter.
- Sound: 6 ambient soundscapes, binaural beats (delta, theta, alpha, beta), 32 music tracks, a sleep sounds player, 4 bells, and a haptic-only mode.
- 4 widgets (Streak, Quick Breathe, Daily Intention, Instant Calm), including lock screen widgets. Live Activity and Dynamic Island. Siri Shortcuts.
- Progress: streaks, a heatmap, mood trend and a health dashboard. 5 levels by total minutes: Seedling, Explorer (60+ min), Warrior (300+), Sage (1000+), Master (3000+). Levels are milestones; nothing is locked behind them.
- Export your data (CSV and JSON). Delete your account any time in Settings. Sign in with Apple, Google or email.
- Bundled sessions work offline.

## About the Creator

- [Collin Chartier](https://groundapp.live/about): Breathwork and mental performance coach and endurance athlete. He built GroundApp to give people the guidance he gives his clients: which breath to use, when, and how to make it a practice.

## Free game

- [Bodie's Breath Run](https://groundapp.live/play): a free browser game with Bodie, the breathing figure from the home page. Race Kip the Caffeine Crow on five courses built around box breathing, breath-hold dives, the physiological sigh, power breaths and glide control. The Big Hold times your longest breath hold (sit down, never in water) and Breath Surf guides resonance, box, 4-7-8, physiological sigh and power breathing. Records stay in your browser.

## Use Cases

- Calming down in a stressful moment
- Winding down for sleep
- Focus and composure before a performance, presentation or competition
- Energy in the morning or before training
- Building a daily breathwork habit
